evidence_quote: Among individuals with HDL-C ≤ 0.5 mmol/L, we identified three pathogenic missense variants in five occurrences across four individuals: ABCA1 p.G1818E (n = 2), LCAT p.M276K (n = 2) and APOA1 p.R184L (n = 1)
note: Population screen; only heterozygous LCAT carriers with low HDL-C, none presented as LCAT deficiency.

evidence_quote: Genetic testing identified a homozygous LCAT mutation (c.355G>C, p.Gly119Arg), with both parents confirmed as heterozygous carriers.
note: Parents are asymptomatic carriers, not counted.
